summary: Service Corporation International filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the Board's decision to reject the conditional resignation of Lead Independent Director Mr. Watts following a majority vote against his election. The Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee engaged with shareholders, finding no concerns about his fitness; proxy advisor opposition related to governance changes. This is routine governance disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, pricing, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for continued shareholder engagement on governance proposals.
